As a brand ambassador, the Sales Manager represents Faena’s distinctive blend of culture, lifestyle, wellness, and hospitality, ensuring the hotel is strongly positioned among luxury travel advisors, entertainment networks, corporate accounts, and high-value clientele. Foster strong working relationships with Accor Global Sales Offices and relevant Ennismore commercial teams to maximize account production. 01354456bd8a76ba.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة الرياض الخليجية عن أخصائي إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم الرئيس المباشر في تحقيق الأهداف الإدارية وتنفيذ مجموعة متنوعة من المهام الإدارية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم لزملاء العمل لضمان نقل الخبرات والمعارف. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة الرئيس المباشر في تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، واقتراح وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيقها. تنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الإدارية المتنوعة حسب توجيهات الرئيس المباشر. تقديم الدعم والمساندة لزملاء العمل الأقل خبرة في الفرع أو الإدارة، والتأكد من نقل المعارف والخبرات اللازمة لتحسين أدائهم. تنفيذ العمليات الإدارية والإجرائية المختلفة لتلبية احتياجات الفرع أو الإدارة. تنفيذ العمليات والمشروعات والمبادرات المتخصصة، وتوظيف الخبرات الفنية لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة لها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء وتنفيذ المهام الإدارية المتنوعة بكفاءة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم لزملاء العمل. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

This ensures timely completion with a quality of work that meets or exceeds client expectations, through the implementation of international quality standards, plans, and procedures across all construction activities. This position also supports the development of the Project Quality Management System by establishing necessary procedures, plans, and work instructions. Key Responsibilities Assist the Project QA/QC Manager or Sr. QA/QC Engineer in implementing the quality management system at the site, in accordance with the approved Project Quality Plan and IMS Procedures. 012e4adf572cf044.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Plant Propagator to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for the propagation, establishment, and management of plant material essential for supporting botanic garden collections, displays, conservation programs, and horticulture operations. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview The Plant Propagator will apply a range of propagation methods, including seeds, cuttings, grafting, division, and other vegetative techniques, to produce healthy and genetically appropriate plant stock. Key responsibilities include managing nursery areas and propagation stock, developing protocols for rare and difficult-to-propagate species, and monitoring plants through various establishment stages. The role also involves maintaining detailed propagation records and evaluating success rates to continuously improve techniques and support the long-term sustainability and conservation value of plant collections. Key Responsibilities Propagate plants using diverse techniques such as seeds, cuttings, grafting, budding, layering, and division, selecting methods based on species, seasonal needs, and collection objectives. Collect, prepare, process, and store seeds and vegetative propagation material, assessing their quality and viability. Prepare appropriate propagation media and containers, applying necessary seed treatments like scarification or stratification. Undertake specialist propagation activities including grafting, budding, and division, and treat cuttings to promote successful rooting. Monitor germination, rooting, establishment, growth, and overall plant health, identifying and addressing issues such as disease, pests, or nutrient deficiencies. Manage and maintain nursery and propagation areas, ensuring optimal growing conditions, hygiene, and plant-care standards. Manage nursery plant stock to meet the requirements of garden collections, seasonal displays, and conservation programs. Monitor and manage environmental factors such as irrigation, humidity, shade, and temperature within propagation areas. Coordinate the movement of propagated plants to various garden environments and support their hardening and acclimatisation. Develop, test, and refine species-specific propagation protocols, particularly for rare and endangered species, and conduct trials to improve success rates. Collaborate with curators, botanists, horticulturists, and conservation specialists to identify propagation priorities. Maintain detailed records of all propagation activities, methods, source material, dates, treatments, and success rates. Maintain accurate nursery stock inventories and update relevant plant collection databases. Implement appropriate nursery hygiene, sanitation, plant-health, and biosecurity procedures, supporting Integrated Pest Management (IPM). Ensure compliance with health and safety, environment, and horticulture operating procedures. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in plant propagation or a related horticultural field. Demonstrated knowledge of various plant propagation methods, including seeds, cuttings, grafting, and division. Ability to manage nursery environments and maintain plant health. Strong record-keeping skills for propagation activities and inventory management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, involving hands-on work in nursery and propagation areas within a botanic garden setting. The role requires attention to detail and adherence to strict hygiene and safety protocols. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this Plant Propagator position with Eram Talent in Saudi Arabia.

0141194b576dcc50.description: Role Overview The Treasury Manager is responsible for managing the company’s cash flow, liquidity, banking relationships, financing arrangements, guarantees, and overall treasury operations. The position ensures that sufficient funds are available to support ongoing construction projects and corporate operations while optimizing cash utilization, minimizing financial risks, and maintaining strong relationships with banks and financial institutions. Key Responsibilities 1. Treasury Management Manage the company’s daily treasury and cash management operations. Monitor cash positions, bank balances, inflows, and outflows. Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and long-term cash flow forecasts. Ensure adequate liquidity to meet project and corporate financial obligations. Optimize utilization of available cash and working capital. Monitor cash requirements for multiple construction projects. 2. Cash Flow Management Develop and maintain project-wise and company-wide cash flow forecasts. Monitor customer collections, project billing, subcontractor payments, payroll, suppliers, and other major cash movements. Identify potential cash shortages or surpluses and recommend appropriate actions. Coordinate closely with Finance, Accounts, Commercial, Procurement, and Project teams. Monitor working capital and improve cash conversion. 3. Banking & Financial Institutions Manage relationships with local and international banks. Negotiate banking facilities, credit lines, overdrafts, and other financial arrangements. Coordinate opening and maintenance of corporate and project bank accounts. Monitor bank charges, interest rates, commissions, and banking service agreements. Review and negotiate banking terms to achieve favorable commercial conditions. 4. Bank Guarantees & Letters of Credit Manage the complete lifecycle of Bank Guarantees (BGs), including: Performance Guarantees Advance Payment Guarantees Retention Guarantees Bid Bonds Other contractual guarantees Coordinate issuance, amendment, extension, reduction, and cancellation of guarantees. Monitor expiry dates and ensure timely renewal or release. Manage Letters of Credit (LCs) and other trade finance instruments where applicable. Maintain accurate records of all guarantees, LCs, and related bank facilities. 5. Construction Project Finance Monitor project-specific cash requirements and funding needs. Coordinate with Project Managers and Commercial teams regarding project billing and collections. Monitor advance payments, retention amounts, progress payments, and project receivables. Analyze project cash flow against approved budgets and forecasts. Support management in identifying project-level financial risks. 6. Accounts Receivable & Collections Monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables. Coordinate with Accounts Receivable and Commercial teams to improve collection performance. Track overdue invoices, retention receivables, and certified/unbilled amounts. Prepare collection forecasts and highlight potential cash flow risks to management. 7. Payments & Disbursements Review and monitor major supplier, subcontractor, payroll, tax, and project-related payments. Ensure payments are made in accordance with approved authorization procedures. Maintain appropriate payment controls and segregation of duties. Monitor payment schedules and prioritize payments according to cash availability and contractual obligations. 8. Foreign Exchange & Financial Risk Monitor foreign currency exposure arising from international suppliers, contractors, and project transactions. Assist management in managing foreign exchange and interest-rate risks. Monitor financial market conditions and recommend appropriate treasury strategies. Ensure compliance with approved treasury risk-management policies. 9. Financing & Working Capital Assist senior management in arranging project and corporate financing. Evaluate financing requirements and available banking facilities. Monitor loan balances, repayments, interest, and financing costs. Optimize working capital and financing structures. Prepare financial analysis for new financing requirements. 10. Treasury Reporting & Controls Prepare treasury reports, cash flow forecasts, liquidity reports, and banking reports for senior management. Maintain accurate treasury records and supporting documentation. Perform regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies. Establish and maintain effective treasury controls and procedures. Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable Saudi regulations. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. 6 - 10 years of relevant experience in Treasury/Finance. Strong experience in cash flow management, banking facilities, guarantees, letters of credit, and working capital management. Proven experience managing relationships with major local and international banks. Strong knowledge of banking products, trade finance, and financial instruments. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar. Advanced knowledge of MS Excel and financial modeling. Fluency in Arabic and Proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications & Experience Professional certification such as CFA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or CTP. Relevant experience within the Construction, Contracting, EPC, or Infrastructure sector.

Role Focus The position is primarily responsible for: People leadership, coaching, and team development Operational performance and KPI management Customer satisfaction and escalation management Safety compliance and service readiness Contract execution, quality, and profitability Cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement activities To succeed, you will need Experience and Knowledge Proven experience leading or developing field service, operational or technical teams with different competence levels. Experience managing performance, resource planning, service execution, customer issues and operational improvement. Working knowledge of compressed-air equipment and service operations is strongly preferred, including experience with oil-injected and oil-free compressors, dryers and related systems. Ability to review and interpret service performance information and technical job reports sufficiently to guide action and escalate to the appropriate technical specialists. Good command of Microsoft Office and confidence using operational systems and performance data. Understanding of safety requirements, field-service risk management and disciplined work practices. Experience with competitor equipment or service environments is an advantage. Education Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering. Candidates with a recognized technical diploma or apprenticeship and at least five years of relevant compressed-air industry experience may also be considered. In return, we offer Culture of trust and accountability Lifelong learning and career growth Innovation powered by people Comprehensive compensation and benefits Health and well-being Job location This role requires you to work on-site at our office in Riyadh, KSA. You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face-to-face collaboration. Preferred candidate Years of experience 5+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

01dfe73fbc2f8798.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الطريق العريض للمقاولات عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير نقطة اتصال أولى احترافية للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم المواعيد، وضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بسلاسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب وتحديد متطلباتهم وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية عالية. مهارات اتصال ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل في بيئة مهنية منظمة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة بعد المقابلة.

019e66c915a0a0d5.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. Position Overview The Engineering and Manufacturing Tools Tech Specialist to support our expanding manufacturing operations in King Abdullah Economic City, Saudi Arabia. This is a critical, full-time onsite role requiring hands-on experience and deep technical expertise in PLM systems, with a focus on Delmia, Catia, and the 3DExperience platform. The ideal candidate will have proficient experience in 3DExperience, DELMIA, CATIA, ENOVIA, change management, Manufacturing Bill of Material (MBOM), Bill of Process (BOP), Resource allocation, MES and ERP data integrations, and overall manufacturing system architecture. The candidate who fills this role will be expected to engage with a wide customer base regarding onsite support, testing, development, documentation and user training. Ideal candidates shall exhibit a self-starter and collaborative attitude with an appreciation for learning while approaching their work with vigor and determination. Candidates will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, effectively communicate in English with customers, possess the ability to learn quickly, and strive for perfection within a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Key Responsibilities Provide technical leadership and day-to-day customer support for tools related to CATIA, DELMIA, ENOVIA and the 3DExperience PLM platform. Support and troubleshoot the Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOM) and Bill of Process (BOP) for Lucid’s AMP-2 factory. Support AMP-2 manufacturing process planning, BOM creation, resource allocation, and data validation using Delmia and related tools. Ensure AMP-2 manufacturing data integration and synchronization between Lucid’s PLM, MES, and ERP systems. Support the Engineering and Manufacturing change management processes within PLM to maintain data integrity and traceability. Deliver hands-on user support, issue resolution, and system troubleshooting for AMP-2 manufacturing teams. Develop and deliver user training, documentation and support for new and existing PLM tools and processes. Collaborate cross-functionally with Lucid Engineering, IT, MES, ERP, ME, NPI and other manufacturing teams to align PLM capabilities with business needs. Act as an extension of the PLM team in a fast-paced, startup-like manufacturing setting with the ability to work independently and autonomously. Skills Strong written and verbal communication skills in English with the ability to collaborate in a virtual setting. Comfortable engaging across all organizational levels, from executives to working level teams, in the areas of: 3DEXPERIENCE platform CATIA, DELMIA, ENOVIA MBOM/BOP creation and management Manufacturing data validation and integration Strong understanding of data flows between PLM, MES, and ERP systems. Proven experience with Change Management processes in PLM environments. Ability to deliver end-user support, resolve technical issues, and conduct training sessions. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working in a newly established manufacturing site. Communication skills in Arabic are a plus. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering or a related technical field. 2-5 years of experience working with PLM systems within manufacturing environments, automotive preferred. Work experience in greenfield or early-phase manufacturing operations. Previous experience working in the automotive industry. Work experience in a global or multicultural environment. Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website. Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

011cfac4e6db3c93.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بيت العرب الحديثة عن فني صيانة آلات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في صيانة المعدات الكهربائية. يركز الدور على ضمان التشغيل الفعال والموثوق لمعدات الغسيل وأنظمتها من خلال تطبيق برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية. المهام الرئيسية يتولى فني صيانة الآلات الكهربائية مسؤولية دراسة المخططات الفنية ومتابعة إجراءات التشغيل، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الفحوص النهائية قبل التشغيل. تشمل المهام الأساسية ما يلي: دراسة المخططات المتعلقة بتنفيذ أعمال التركيب والصيانة لمعدات الغسيل وملحقاتها. متابعة إجراءات التشغيل وإجراء الفحوص النهائية لمرحلة ما قبل التشغيل. متابعة إجراءات تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية لمعدات الغسيل وأنظمتها. المسؤوليات اليومية يُكلف شاغل الوظيفة بضمان جودة أعمال الصيانة والالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية ومعايير السلامة. تتضمن المسؤوليات اليومية ما يلي: التأكد من مراقبة جميع برامج وخطط الصيانة الوقائية لمعدات الغسيل وملحقاتها الواقعة تحت إشرافه. مراقبة تنفيذ وتطبيق برنامج المراقبة للجودة النوعية والهندسية لضمان توافق أعمال الإصلاحات والتشغيل والصيانة مع المواصفات والقياسات الهندسية. التأكد من اتباع إجراءات وسياسات الأمن والسلامة في جميع أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل. تقديم التقارير اللازمة للمهندس بخصوص أي أعطال أو إصلاحات قد تؤثر على الرعاية الصحية للمرضى. القيام بأية مهام أخرى يكلف بها ضمن نطاق الاختصاص. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك الخبرة العملية والمعرفة الفنية اللازمة في صيانة الآلات الكهربائية. تشمل المتطلبات الأساسية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة الآلات الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الفنية والكهربائية. معرفة قوية بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة الآلات الكهربائية ضمن فريق متخصص في نجران، في بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالجودة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الحضور المنتظم لضمان استمرارية العمليات التشغيلية والصيانة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في مجموعة بيت العرب الحديثة. سيتم مراجعة الطلبات واختيار المرشحين بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات المطلوبة.

0129f8bd66f1c9e1.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز محور الطفل ضيافة الأطفال الأهلية عن معلم صعوبات التعلم للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الدعم التعليمي والفني للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة، بالإضافة إلى توجيه الطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحقيق أقصى إمكاناتهم التعليمية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتناسب مع الأهداف المحددة، واختيار المصادر، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس، وطرق التدريس والمحتوى، مع نسخ المواد التعليمية بالشكل المناسب. تدريس الطلاب، سواء بشكل فردي أو في مجموعات صغيرة، كيفية استخدام التقنيات المتخصصة لتلبية احتياجاتهم، وتقديم الدروس والواجبات، وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الكفاءة والتعامل مع احتياجاتهم الخاصة، والتواصل مع مقدمي الخدمات التعليمية والطبية لتحديد الخطط والأولويات الإنمائية. التعاون مع المدرسين والباحثين لتطوير طرق جديدة لإرشاد الأطفال من ذوي الإعاقة ودعمهم. تثقيف العامة بشأن الأطفال ذوي الإعاقة وكيفية تلبية هذه الاحتياجات في الحياة اليومية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تعليم صعوبات التعلم أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم الدعم التعليمي والفني للأطفال ذوي الإعاقة. مهارات تواصل قوية لتقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات التخطيط والتصميم التعليمي. القدرة على التكيف مع الاحتياجات التعليمية المتنوعة. مهارات التعاون والعمل الجماعي. الوعي بقضايا الأطفال ذوي الإعاقة. بيئة العمل يعمل معلم صعوبات التعلم ضمن فريق مركز محور الطفل ضيافة الأطفال الأهلية في جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع الأطفال وأولياء أمورهم والجهات التعليمية والطبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

012ed0aaf4d0bacc.description: About the Role Apex Aether is seeking a Sales Account Manager to manage client relationships and drive revenue growth across its portfolio of cloud, cybersecurity, IT-operations, data, and business-platforms. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working with enterprise clients throughout the Kingdom. The role requires 2-5 years of experience and offers a competitive salary based on qualifications. Role Overview The Sales Account Manager will serve as a consultative seller, building trust with clients and translating technical capabilities into clear business value. This role involves understanding client objectives and aligning them with appropriate Apex solutions, working in close collaboration with pre-sales and engineering teams to secure and maintain accounts. Key Responsibilities Manage and expand a portfolio of enterprise accounts across Saudi Arabia. Identify and develop opportunities across cloud, cybersecurity, IT operations, data, and business platforms. Collaborate with pre-sales and engineering teams to develop and present proposals and pricing to clients. Maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data within the CRM system, consistently meeting sales targets. Cultivate long-term client relationships to ensure renewals, expansions, and referrals. Required Qualifications and Experience B2B Technology Sales: Proven track record in selling IT, cloud, or cybersecurity solutions, preferably within Saudi Arabia. Solution Understanding: Ability to comprehend cloud, security, IT operations, data, and business-platform services and effectively map them to client requirements. Relationship Building: Demonstrated credibility with both technical and executive stakeholders. Commercial Skills: Proficiency in discovery, negotiation, and closing sales. Preferred Qualifications An existing network of enterprise or public-sector contacts within Saudi Arabia. Experience selling Google Cloud or solutions from major security vendors such as Fortinet, CyberArk, or Kaspersky. A degree in business, IT, or a related field. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time Sales Account Manager position in Riyadh.

01358131f9ffb530.description: About the Role Daikin Saudi is seeking an HVAC Operator - Industrial Refrigeration to join their team in the Riyadh Region. This full-time role involves the installation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of various HVAC systems, with a focus on industrial refrigeration. The operator will perform hands-on service work independently at customer sites and coordinate closely with supervisors and service teams. Key Responsibilities Service air-cooled and centrifugal chillers, VRV/DX systems, industrial ammonia refrigeration plants, and commercial refrigeration units. Diagnose electrical, mechanical, and control faults, and implement corrective actions. Support commissioning, operation, and maintenance activities in adherence to OEM standards. Identify root causes of issues, work to reduce repeat breakdowns, and optimize system performance through servicing and adjustments. Escalate complex or recurring technical issues to appropriate personnel when necessary. Customer Interaction and Documentation Represent the service team professionally at customer sites. Communicate service activities, findings, and recommendations clearly to customers. Complete service reports, checklists, and all job documentation accurately and on time. Record system data, identified faults, and actions taken during service calls. Coordinate effectively with supervisors, planners, and spare parts teams to ensure efficient service delivery. Safety and Professional Development Adhere strictly to all safety procedures, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and permit systems. Handle tools, equipment, and refrigerants safely and responsibly. Stay current with product knowledge and service best practices through continuous learning. Actively participate in training programs and apply new knowledge in field activities. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in HVAC operations, particularly with industrial refrigeration systems. The role requires a strong technical understanding of HVAC and refrigeration principles, along with practical skills in troubleshooting and repair. Work Environment This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working independently at various customer sites. The role is full-time and requires a commitment to maintaining high service standards and safety protocols.

013a486d1b2cb4f7.description: About the Role The System Security Developer will be responsible for developing solutions to production security problems and implementing network and application security measures. This full-time role is based in either Riyadh or Medina, and is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview This position focuses on enhancing organizational security through the development of protective software and forensic tools. The System Security Developer will play a key role in safeguarding systems from unauthorized access and ensuring the integrity of company data. Key Responsibilities Develop approaches to resolve current production security problems. Configure and support firewalls, antivirus software, patch-management systems, and other security tools. Implement network and application security policies, access controls, and company data safeguards. Analyze security requirements and recommend improvements; conduct vulnerability and network scanning assessments. Defend systems from unauthorized access, modification, or destruction, and monitor traffic for suspicious activity. Train colleagues on security awareness and procedures; provide technical security advice. Develop and install protective software, including firewalls, and design and implement forensic software tools and systems. Required Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position. The successful candidate will be based in either Riyadh or Medina. Application Process Salary information for this role will be disclosed during the interview process.

015f96438d2866c7.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن فني صيانة أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان الأداء الأمثل للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الإلكترونية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية بدقة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة اللازمة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة تنفيذ أنشطة الصيانة اللازمة وإجراءات إصلاح الأعطال. فحص الأجهزة والمعدات بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في صيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الإلكترونية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير الاحتياجات من المواد والمستلزمات. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في فحص الأجهزة بعد الإصلاح. مهارات تنظيمية لإعداد التقارير وحفظها. الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة عمل الأجهزة الإلكترونية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

017a57dfd3bfd327.description: About Hewlett Packard Enterprise Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) focuses on accelerating customer transformation across data, connectivity, cloud, and security. The company values flexibility and autonomy, enabling team members to balance work and personal needs. HPE team members are expected to be positive, empathetic, and enterprising, contributing to the company's goals and making a difference. Data Solutions and Storage Internship Overview This internship offers an opportunity to gain real-world experience within the Data Solutions team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Data Solutions team is responsible for HPE’s Hybrid Cloud Vision and addressing partner and customer demand in key areas. As a Data Solutions and Storage Intern, you will support the team with hands-on experience, enhancing your knowledge of Hybrid Cloud solutions from storage to compute at a presales level. The role involves working with a knowledgeable team focused on megatrends and exceeding partner/customer expectations. Key Responsibilities Support proposals and customer engagements across projects of varying sizes and complexities. Engage with HPE Hybrid Cloud Product Management teams to contribute to the future portfolio. Participate in early-stage conversations and build capability by collaborating closely with the local team. Assist the local team on live engagements, from initial scoping through delivery. Private Cloud Solutions: Delivering turnkey solutions for edge-to-core environments based on HPE technology. Cyber Resilience Solutions: Implementing solutions based on Zerto or other integrations with ISV partners. Future Solution Definition: Defining the future direction of solutions and their integration into the HPE GreenLake offering. Qualifications and Experience Experience required: 0-1 years. Interest in Hybrid Cloud solutions, storage, and compute at a presales level. Ability to work effectively within an established team. Internship Program Details The HPE internship program provides opportunities for professional development, exposure to leaders, and networking with other interns. Key aspects include learning and professional development, social and networking events, and volunteer opportunities. Interns are assigned meaningful projects to make an immediate impact at HPE.

0187ff818bb5653f.description: دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية وتقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشخيص أعطال التمديدات وتحديد الإجراءات اللازمة لمعالجتها.

018fd98afaf84296.description: About exequt exequt is a consulting and technology services firm specializing in cybersecurity, IAM, cloud, AI-driven platforms, and custom software engineering. The company partners with public and private sector organizations to deliver digital transformation initiatives across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The Role exequt is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and involves ensuring high availability, security, and scalability for containerized workloads across production and non-production environments. The role requires 3-7 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and manage Kubernetes clusters. Manage Kubernetes resources including Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Ingress, Namespaces, and Persistent Volumes. Implement container orchestration using Kubernetes and Docker/container runtimes. Monitor cluster health, performance, availability, and resource utilization. Configure RBAC, network policies, security controls, and secrets management. Manage cluster upgrades, patching, scaling, backup, and disaster recovery. Troubleshoot application, networking, storage, and cluster-level issues. Implement High Availability (HA) and scalability for Kubernetes workloads. Integrate Kubernetes with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, logging, and DevOps tools. Automate infrastructure and deployments using Helm, Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools. Work with cloud Kubernetes platforms such as OpenShift, AKS, EKS, or GKE where applicable. Compensation and Benefits Performance-based compensation structure. Bupa medical insurance (Golden Tier). Ongoing training and mentorship from experienced leadership. Exposure to projects with clients in Saudi Arabia. A collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

01aafb286eee1f7f.description: About Us Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others. Your Role We're seeking an Engineering Manager II to lead a critical area of our engineering organization. In this role, you will be accountable for the delivery and technical strategy across multiple complex and related domains within our product. You will lead a high-performing team of 6-10 senior engineers, potentially structured across two squads, driving the execution of team-level goals that are directly aligned with broader organizational priorities. Drawing on your deep expertise in software development and proven leadership, you will guide the architectural evolution of your team's systems, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and performant. You will be a key partner to product and business leadership, influencing medium- and long-term strategy and ensuring your teams are focused on delivering measurable impact. Your ultimate responsibility is to orchestrate technical excellence, foster the growth of senior engineers and future leaders, manage complex cross-team dependencies, and transform how millions of users engage in shopping, payment, and banking activities. You are a driven, determined, and curious leader, who knows that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges. You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success. Your Responsibilities Leadership & Strategy: Inspire and guide a group of senior engineers, setting a clear direction that aligns with the company vision. Drive alignment between technology goals and product priorities, advocating for long-term technical quality alongside short-term delivery. People Leadership & Development: Develop both direct reports and skip-levels for future leadership roles. Create growth opportunities for senior engineers, mentor those aspiring to become Engineering Manager I's, and support the success of new managers. Drive team structure decisions, hiring plans, and succession planning while effectively managing performance across all levels. Technical Excellence: Lead architectural discussions for your team's systems. Drive continuous improvements to system reliability, performance, and scalability. Monitor technical health and ensure the team maintains a healthy balance between new feature delivery and technical investment. Execution & Delivery: Define and own the delivery plans for initiatives that span multiple teams. Own resource allocation and hiring strategy for your area. Proactively identify and resolve complex cross-team delivery challenges, making strategic trade-offs between short- and long-term value. Provide clear visibility to leadership on project status, risks, and mitigation strategies. Product & Business Partnership: Partner directly with Product and business leadership to influence medium- and long-term product strategies. Ensure your teams are focusing on measurable outcomes and ROI, and encourage a culture of thoughtful experimentation aligned with strategic goals. Team Health & Collaboration: Build a healthy, inclusive environment of trust, ownership, and accountability. Foster a strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing culture. Work closely with peer Engineering Managers and the architecture board to ensure alignment and drive standards across the engineering organization. Your Expertise You have at least 4+ years of experience managing one or more engineering teams, with a proven track record of managing senior individual contributors and leading projects of medium-to-high complexity. Demonstrated experience owning delivery for initiatives spanning multiple teams or complex product domains. Strong technical background in modern software development (e.g., Java/Go, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Messaging Queues, Cloud Services), with experience leading architectural discussions and driving technical strategy. Experience partnering with product managers to influence product roadmaps and align technical strategy with business objectives. Proven ability to develop engineering talent, including mentoring senior engineers and aspiring managers. Expertise in Agile methodologies and experience resolving complex, cross-team delivery challenges in a fast-paced environment. Fintech or eCommerce experience is a strong plus.

01bd30c2493d1be3.description: About the Role TalentHive is partnering with a diversified Saudi Group with significant operations in construction, infrastructure, industrial services, heavy equipment, transportation, logistics, and workforce accommodation. As the Group expands its operations across the Kingdom, we are seeking an experienced Facilities Manager to strengthen its integrated facilities and accommodation services in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves transforming the existing Facilities Management function and building high-performing teams. Role Context and Objectives This position requires leadership in a complex operational environment, focusing on introducing efficient working methods and developing a scalable, commercially driven Facilities Management function. The Facilities Manager will be involved in operational activities while also possessing the leadership capabilities to establish systems, improve performance, and drive significant change within the organization. Key Responsibilities Lead integrated hard and soft FM services across industrial facilities, workforce accommodation, operational sites, and associated infrastructure. Oversee maintenance, utilities, housekeeping, laundry, cleaning, building systems, and specialist service providers. Ensure reliable, safe, and consistent service delivery across multiple locations, including remote and operationally demanding environments. Strengthen and transform the existing FM operating model, introducing and improving SOPs, SLAs, KPIs, governance structures, and performance reporting. Transition operations from reactive problem-solving towards planned, preventive, and data-driven service delivery. Support the implementation and effective use of CAFM/CMMS platforms, digital reporting, and operational dashboards. Manage operating budgets, cost efficiency, supplier contracts, and service profitability. Identify opportunities to improve productivity, asset reliability, and resource utilization without compromising service quality. Support new site mobilization, contract delivery, and future business expansion. Build, coach, and develop multidisciplinary teams across hard and soft services. Strengthen ownership, accountability, succession planning, and cross-functional collaboration. Drive improvements in client satisfaction, service responsiveness, and operational standards. Champion HSE, fire/life safety, compliance, and business continuity across all facilities. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in Facilities Management. Demonstrated experience in transforming and strengthening integrated facilities and accommodation services. Proven ability to manage complex operational environments and build high-performing teams. Experience with SOPs, SLAs, KPIs, governance structures, and performance reporting. Familiarity with CAFM/CMMS platforms, digital reporting, and operational dashboards. Strong commercial and financial management skills, including budget management and contract negotiation. Career Development Opportunities Opportunity to shape and improve how facilities and accommodation services are managed, measured, and delivered. Work across diverse environments including industrial, construction, infrastructure, and workforce accommodation. Collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence operational improvements across the business. Potential for broader leadership responsibility within an expanding Group. Direct impact on operational reliability, customer satisfaction, team performance, and commercial outcomes. Application Process We invite experienced Saudi Facilities Management professionals who are focused on building stronger operations, developing people, and delivering measurable improvements to apply for this leadership opportunity.

01d12dc17d906ca6.company_name: Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia
01d12dc17d906ca6.description: About the Role Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia, is seeking a Director of Residences for its Red Sea location, specifically at Shura Island, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and reports directly to the General Manager. The Director of Residences will lead the full residential operation, ensuring high levels of personalized service and operational excellence for residence owners, residents, and guests. Role Overview The Director of Residences will oversee all aspects of the residences experience, including owner relations, residential services, property management coordination, service standards, financial oversight, and team leadership. This position is key to creating a seamless connection between the resort and residences while consistently delivering Four Seasons standards. As a senior leader, the role also involves promoting a respectful, supportive, and service-focused environment for all stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee all Residences operations, ensuring exceptional service delivery and adherence to Four Seasons standards. Build and maintain strong relationships with residence owners, residents, and key stakeholders. Oversee residential services, including owner requests, arrivals/departures, housekeeping coordination, maintenance follow-up, concierge support, and lifestyle services. Collaborate with Rooms, Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, Finance, Food & Beverage, and People & Culture to ensure seamless support. Implement and monitor operating procedures, service standards, and quality controls for all residential services. Ensure all residence areas are maintained to high standards of cleanliness, safety, comfort, and presentation. Manage owner and resident feedback, concerns, and service recovery with professionalism and urgency. Support the preparation and management of residential budgets, service charges, forecasts, and operational expenses. Monitor performance indicators, service trends, owner satisfaction, and operational effectiveness. Ensure compliance with local regulations, property policies, brand standards, and management agreements. Lead, coach, train, and develop the Residences team, fostering a culture of accountability and service excellence. Support operational activities, residential readiness, handover processes, system implementation, and owner communication plans. Represent the residences professionally in meetings, inspections, owner interactions, and operational planning. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience as a Director of Residences, Residences Manager, Director of Rooms, or senior operations leader within a luxury hotel, branded residences, or high-end residential environment. Strong understanding of luxury residential operations, owner relations, property management, and personalized service standards. Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build, coach, and develop a high-performing team. Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgets, service charges, cost control, and operational planning. High level of discretion, professionalism, integrity, and emotional intelligence. Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work closely with resort operations while maintaining the privacy and expectations of residence owners and residents. Candidates must be eligible to work in Saudi Arabia. About the Location The Red Sea destination, located along 200 kms of coastline between Umluj and Al Wajh, is being developed with sustainable practices at its core. The new Four Seasons Resort will be situated on Shura Island, a central hub featuring a yacht marina, leisure facilities, retail, and an 18-hole golf course. The resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting spaces, a marine discovery centre, and a full-service spa. Company Culture Four Seasons is committed to a culture of excellence and respect, where individuals are recognized and treated with care. The company aims to create lasting impressions for guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury delivered with genuine heart.

01d7193fb593354c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شلفا لإدارة المرافق عن أخصائي مناقصات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد وتطوير شروط ومعايير المناقصات، ومتابعة تنفيذ عمليات إعدادها، بالإضافة إلى تحليل العروض الفنية والمالية لضمان اختيار الأنسب. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة شروط ومعايير المناقصات، بما في ذلك معايير اختيار العروض وكفالات حسن التنفيذ والغرامات. متابعة وتنفيذ عمليات إعداد المناقصات والمشاركة في لجان فتح المظاريف وفحص العروض. جمع البيانات ومراجعتها ومناقشتها وإعادة صياغتها، والتأكد من مطابقتها للشروط النظامية والسياسات والإجراءات والبنود القانونية المعتمدة. الإعلان عن المناقصات وتحديد الجهات المستهدفة، ومتابعة العمليات لضمان استلام الجهات لهذه المناقصات، واستلام عروض الموردين. تحليل العروض الفنية والمالية، وفتحها وفرزها، واتخاذ القرار بشأن اختيار الأنسب منها بناءً على السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمناقصات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المناقصات أو ما يعادله. فهم عميق لشروط ومعايير المناقصات وإجراءات إعدادها. القدرة على تحليل العروض الفنية والمالية بدقة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والمشاركة في اللجان. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات القانونية المعتمدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم للراغبين في التقديم، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

01df0f97255d7aff.description: About UXBERT Labs UXBERT Labs, part of the Supertech Group, is a digital and user experience design agency in the GCC. The Supertech Group also includes Hala Yalla, a private event ticketing and experience booking platform, and Kafu Games, an esports tournament platform in MENA. UXBERT Labs works with regional and international brands such as STC, Amazon, and Gucci, focusing on UX/CX, software development, and AI-powered digital transformation. Role Overview: CEO/Commercial Growth Partner This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is for a CEO/Commercial Growth Partner responsible for driving the commercial and market expansion of UXBERT Labs. This position is designed for a seasoned commercial leader with over 10 years of experience in scaling service-based companies. The role focuses on unlocking high-value opportunities across government, enterprise, and global markets, shaping and executing the company's growth strategy, and strengthening its presence in UX/CX, software development, and AI-powered digital transformation. This is a commercial growth and strategic business partnership role, not a traditional CEO position. Key Responsibilities Lead the company's commercial growth strategy, focusing on revenue expansion and new market penetration. Develop and execute plans to secure large enterprise and government opportunities. Build high-level relationships with C-suite clients, partners, and strategic allies. Drive global and regional market-entry opportunities. Secure partnerships with technology providers, consulting firms, and channel partners to accelerate reach. Develop long-term alliances supporting UX/CX, digital transformation, and AI services. Represent the company in international conferences, forums, and government engagements. Oversee high-value bids, proposal strategies, pricing frameworks, and negotiations for large deals. Build new commercial models and explore diversification of revenue streams (*, training, AI products, managed services). Strengthen sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and revenue planning. Build and develop a high-performing commercial and sales organization. Define go-to-market strategies for UX, CX, QA services, software development, digital transformation, and AI consulting. Introduce systems for lead generation, partner-led sales, and enterprise outbound growth. Develop commercial strategies around AI products, platforms, and consulting services. Build the company's thought leadership globally through events, keynotes, and media visibility. Identify market gaps and propose new AI-driven business opportunities. Work closely with the General Manager to ensure commercial commitments align with operational capability. Support strategic decision-making with market insights, competitive analysis, and commercial intelligence. Collaborate with PMO, Tech, Design, Research, and AI teams to ensure smooth handover from sales to delivery. Own commercial KPIs including revenue growth, new markets, partnerships, bid conversions, and pipeline scaling. Work with finance to optimize pricing, margins, and commercial structures. Qualifications and Experience Professional Experience: 14+ years in Consulting, Digital Transformation, UX/CX, Enterprise Technology, or AI. Proven track record in scaling a services-based company, preferably to multi-million USD revenue levels. Strong background in commercial leadership, business development, or CEO/MD roles. Experience working with large government or enterprise clients in the GCC is a strong advantage. Global experience or exposure to international markets is preferred. Skills & Capabilities: Deep understanding of digital transformation, QA services, software development, user experience, customer experience, and AI solutions. Exceptional commercial acumen, including the ability to close large deals and build long-term revenue pipelines. Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate vision into action and execution. Ability to sustain and continue building high-performing teams and drive operational excellence. Excellent communication skills, executive presence, and stakeholder management. Role Impact and Objectives This role is critical for UXBERT Labs as the company enters a phase of acceleration. The primary objectives are to elevate the company to the next level, unlock untapped commercial potential, expand regionally and globally, and transform the company into a dominant digital and AI consulting powerhouse. The focus areas include revenue generation, strategic partnerships, market entry, and global expansion. Benefits Opportunity to lead and scale a company with a strong legacy, credibility, and experience in major national projects. A strategic partnership role offering high autonomy and influence. A culture that promotes innovation, agility, and forward-thinking. A competitive compensation package with performance-linked incentives.

01e6451dd715dddf.description: About the Content Trainee Role Nice One is seeking a Content Trainee to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as part of the Tamheer Program. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are looking to gain practical experience in content creation and management within a professional environment. The trainee will support the planning, creation, editing, and publishing of engaging content across various digital and communication channels. Role Purpose and Development The Content Trainee will contribute to maintaining a consistent brand voice while developing skills in content writing, research, content management, and performance monitoring. This position offers an opportunity to learn and apply best practices in content development under the guidance of experienced professionals. Key Responsibilities Assist with researching, writing, editing, and proofreading content for websites, blogs, social media, and email campaigns. Support the development of content ideas, briefs, editorial calendars, and publishing schedules in coordination with content and marketing teams. Create clear, accurate, and engaging written content that aligns with the company’s brand voice and communication standards. Conduct research on relevant topics, audiences, keywords, industry developments, and competitor content. Assist with adapting content for different audiences, platforms, formats, and stages of the customer journey. Review content for grammar, spelling, readability, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand guidelines. Support the creation and editing of basic visual content, captions, and multimedia assets. Help upload, format, categorize, and maintain content in the company website, content management system, and other publishing tools. Assist with search engine optimization (SEO) by researching keywords and applying on-page content best practices. Monitor published content for accuracy, formatting, links, and relevance, recommending updates as needed. Track content performance using analytics tools and assist in preparing reports on reach, engagement, and traffic. Coordinate with marketing, design, product, sales, and other internal teams to gather information for content projects. Incorporate feedback and revisions from reviewers while maintaining accuracy and consistency. Organize content files, drafts, references, approvals, and published materials according to company procedures. Adhere to company policies, brand guidelines, copyright requirements, and confidentiality standards. Participate in training, coaching, team meetings, and learning activities as part of the Tamheer program. Perform other content and marketing support responsibilities as assigned. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Strong written communication skills. Ability to conduct research and synthesize information effectively. Attention to detail for proofreading and editing. Familiarity with digital content channels and platforms is beneficial. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working collaboratively with various internal teams in a dynamic environment. Application Process Candidates interested in this Content Trainee position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

01f8fa7a919d0042.description: About the Role GS Engineering & Construction is seeking a QC Equipment Preservation Inspector (Static) to join the Quality Control Department for the Fadhili Project in Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on ensuring the preservation standards for static equipment. Key Responsibilities Conducting quality control inspections for the preservation of static equipment. Ensuring compliance with project specifications and industry standards. Reviewing and managing transmittal documents related to equipment preservation. Preparing and maintaining detailed inspection reports. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, with a major in Mechanical Engineering or a similar field. Minimum of 5 years of work experience with Saudi Aramco, specifically involving transmittal documents. Must be Saudi Aramco certified with a SAP number reference. Candidates with a CBT pass document are preferred; however, Saudi Aramco experience with transmittal documents without a CBT pass is also acceptable. Possession of an API Certificate is considered an advantage. Required Skills Proficiency in MS Office applications. Good command of both verbal and written English communication. Location and Interview Process This position is based in Saudi Arabia. Candidates currently residing in Saudi Arabia and available for a face-to-face interview are preferred. Application Information The salary for this role will be disclosed during the interview process.

012b36184916b545.description: Financial Analyst Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Job Type: Full-time Seniority Level: Mid-Level Experience: 2–5 years Job Objective We are looking for a Financial Analyst to join our team to analyze financial data, deliver actionable insights, build forecasts, and support management in making data-driven strategic decisions. Key Responsibilities Financial Analysis & Reporting: Analyze financial data and reports to deliver clear insights to management. Prepare periodic financial reports and track key performance indicators (KPIs). Budgeting & Variance Analysis: Evaluate revenues, expenses, cash flows, and budgets. Prepare financial forecasts and analyze variances between actual and planned results. Decision Support & Modeling: Build financial models and analytical reports using Excel to support business operations, investment decisions, and special projects. Data Integrity & Collaboration: Review financial data for accuracy and completeness while collaborating across accounting, finance, and operational teams to gather required information. Presentations & Continuous Improvement: Create executive-level financial presentations to communicate performance trends and contribute to streamlining reporting processes. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. Experience: 2–5 years of experience in financial analysis or a related role. Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (complex formulas, PivotTables, data modeling). Core Competencies: Strong foundation in financial and accounting principles. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities. High attention to detail when working with complex numerical datasets. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Soft Skills & Languages: Effective communication, strong team collaboration, and a good command of English. Key Skills Financial Analysis & Modeling Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis Budgeting & Forecasting Advanced Microsoft Excel Data Analysis & Problem-Solving Written & Verbal Communication What We Offer A professional, supportive, and collaborative work environment. Clear opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement. Exposure to a diverse, multidisciplinary team. 0140e8a8cc84ccc8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الخشاب للتجارة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات شاملة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام وضمان ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة بكفاءة. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في المؤسسة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعرض. القدرة على إدارة المخزون وتنظيم المتجر. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة للعمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. ستكون جزءاً من فريق مؤسسة الخشاب للتجارة، حيث ستساهم في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتقديم تجربة تسوق إيجابية للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

014523c9c725ce42.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة GRIVOT للاستشارات والخدمات في الموارد البشرية عن أخصائي مبيعات شركات للانضمام إلى إحدى الشركات المتخصصة في تقديم الحلول التقنية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى معالجة تحديات المطاعم والكافيهات وتحسين تجربة العملاء من خلال حلول تقنية مبتكرة. يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الوصول إلى العملاء المحتملين في قطاع الشركات (B2B). إغلاق صفقات المبيعات بنجاح وتحويل الفرص إلى مبيعات فعلية. بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وتقديم الحلول التقنية المناسبة لاحتياجاتهم. تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص الجديدة لزيادة المبيعات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مبيعات الشركات (B2B). معرفة قوية بسوق الحلول التقنية وقطاع المطاعم والكافيهات. القدرة على تحديد العملاء المحتملين وإدارة دورة المبيعات من البداية حتى الإغلاق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على التفاوض وإقناع العملاء. مهارات قوية في بناء العلاقات وإدارة العملاء. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. تفاصيل العمل يبلغ الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور 5,000 ريال سعودي، بالإضافة إلى عمولات مميزة تعتمد على الأداء. ساعات العمل من السبت إلى الخميس، من الساعة 8 صباحًا حتى 4 مساءً، مع مرونة في الدوام. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن يمتلكون المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة للتقدم لهذا الدور في الرياض.

016f5b816aafb7fa.description: مشرف موارد بشرية (سعودي الجنسية) الموقع: الرياض نوع الدوام: دوام كامل المرجع الوظيفي: مدير الموارد البشرية / المدير العام عن الوظيفة: نبحث عن مشرف موارد بشرية سعودي يتولى الإشراف على عمليات الموارد البشرية اليومية، من التوظيف حتى نهاية الخدمة، ويضمن امتثال المنشأة لنظام العمل السعودي ومتطلبات المنصات الحكومية. المهام والمسؤوليات: - الإشراف على دورة التوظيف كاملة: الإعلان، الفرز، المقابلات، والعروض الوظيفية. - إعداد عقود العمل وتوثيقها في منصة قوى. - متابعة نسب التوطين في نطاقات والتنبيه المبكر لأي انخفاض. - إدارة اشتراكات التأمينات الاجتماعية ورفع ملف حماية الأجور شهرياً عبر مدد. - متابعة الإقامات ورخص العمل والتأشيرات عبر قوى ومقيم وأبشر أعمال. - مراجعة مسير الرواتب الشهري والتنسيق مع الإدارة المالية. - إدارة الإجازات والغياب والعمل الإضافي وملفات الموظفين. - تنفيذ إجراءات نهاية الخدمة والمخالصات وحساب مكافأة نهاية الخدمة. - تنسيق تقييم الأداء السنوي وخطة التدريب ومتابعة فترات التجربة. - معالجة شكاوى الموظفين وتطبيق لائحة تنظيم العمل وجدول الجزاءات. - إعداد تقارير شهرية عن القوى العاملة والدوران الوظيفي والتوطين. - الإشراف على فريق الموارد البشرية وتوزيع المهام ومتابعتها. المؤهلات المطلوبة: - بكالوريوس في إدارة الموارد البشرية أو إدارة الأعمال أو تخصص ذي صلة. - خبرة لا تقل عن 4 سنوات في الموارد البشرية، منها سنتان في دور إشرافي. - خبرة عملية في منصات قوى، التأمينات الاجتماعية، مدد، ومقيم. - معرفة جيدة بنظام العمل السعودي ولائحته التنفيذية وتعديلاته الأخيرة. - إجادة Excel وأنظمة الموارد البشرية الإلكترونية. - لغة عربية ممتازة وإنجليزية جيدة. يُفضّل: - شهادة مهنية مثل SHRM-CP أو CIPD أو aPHRi. - خبرة في منشأة متعددة الفروع أو مجموعة شركات. المهارات الشخصية: - الدقة والسرية في التعامل مع البيانات. - مهارات تواصل وتفاوض وحل نزاعات عالية. - القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط في فترات الرواتب والتقييم. الراتب: يُحدد حسب الخبرة وسلّم الرواتب المعتمد.

0179cd1467af19fa.description: About the Role UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company is seeking a Lifting Supervisor to join their team. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and is responsible for overseeing all lifting and handling operations to ensure they are conducted safely and efficiently, in compliance with company standards and relevant regulations. Role Overview The Lifting Supervisor will be responsible for the direct supervision of all crane lifts on site. This involves meticulous planning, coordination, and execution of lifting activities, alongside comprehensive daily documentation and adherence to site-specific lift plans. The role ensures that all operations meet stringent safety and operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Plan, coordinate, and supervise all lifting activities within the project. Verify that all lifting gears are valid and in operational condition. Conduct pre-task briefings for all lifting team members, including crane operators, riggers, and signalmen, covering the Lifting Plan, risk control measures, and safe lifting procedures. Ensure all lift/riggers adhere to policies outlined in the Lifting Operators Manual. Prepare the Lifting Plan and confirm the validity of the Permit-To-Work (PTW) before commencing any lifting operation. Ensure mobile crane operators and all related lifting equipment operators conduct pre-operation checks using company-prescribed checklists. Verify load weights and radii to ensure proper understanding prior to lifting operations. Conduct area inspections before lifting operations, including setting up barricades and ensuring safety at the lifting area. Coordinate and supervise all lifting activities in strict accordance with the Lifting Plan. Implement suitable measures to rectify any reported unsafe conditions to ensure safe and continuous operation. Conduct on-job training for all lift standards and complete practical training reports. Perform minor maintenance tasks as required. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies. Ensure all rigging tackles used for lifting are in good condition and color-coded as per the monthly color code. Monitor equipment on site and coordinate with the client regarding any complaints, initiating immediate action. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a similar lifting supervision role. Demonstrated understanding of safe lifting and handling operations. Familiarity with local and international regulations and requirements related to lifting operations. Proficiency in preparing lifting plans and completing associated documentation. Skills and Attributes Strong leadership and supervisory skills to manage lifting teams effectively. Excellent communication skills for conducting briefings and coordinating with various stakeholders. Attention to detail for conducting thorough inspections and checks. Ability to identify and rectify unsafe conditions promptly. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

Understanding of how AI agents are built (prompts, tools, memory, guardrails) and proactive identification of workflows suitable for automation. Awareness of AI risks (hallucination, bias, data privacy, over-reliance) and knowledge of what should and should not be AI-assisted.

014497272df51f7c.description: About the Role IDOM Consulting, Engineering, Architecture is seeking a Senior Road Engineer to join its Project and Construction Management team in Riyadh. Responsibilities Provide technical control for all road works and coordinate with discipline specialists and quality control personnel. Demonstrated expertise in technical coordination, quality control, and design review for road infrastructure projects. IDOM values the expertise and experience of its highly qualified team, promoting professional freedom, integrity, and a strong commitment to progress, quality, and innovation. جلسة فعلية واحدة). توثيق الجلسات المعطاة في نموذج تحضير الجلسات الموحّد داخل العيادات. إعطاء جلستين تدريبيتين لكل مستفيد وإضافة جلسة تكثيفية لمستفيد ضعيف الأداء عند غياب مستفيد آخر. تنفيذ جلسة متابعة السلامة داخل العيادات التابعة للخطة الإدارية على نظام ريهادوكس يومياً. تنفيذ جلسة متابعة البيئة التدريبية التابعة للخطة الإدارية على نظام ريهادوكس مرة واحدة أسبوعياً. توثيق الجلسات المعطاة في النموذج المعتمد داخل الفصل. متابعة غياب المستفيدين وتبليغ المشرف/ة. مناقشة الأهداف المشتركة مع مختصي الفصول والعيادات الأخرى لتحقيق أقصى فائدة ممكنة من الخطة التأهيلية. تفعيل دور الخدمات العيادية داخل الفصول ومتابعة التنفيذ مع مختصي الفصول وتوثيقه في النموذج المعتمد لذلك. تحديث ملف الإنجاز وإضافة الدورات والفعاليات وأوراق العمل المنفذة مع المستفيدين خلال الجلسات التدريبية. تعبئة نماذج الخطط التشغيلية الموجودة على البورد داخل العيادات حسب الأحداث المذكورة فيها. استقبال حالات الحساب الخاص والدعم المسجلة في الخدمة حسب توزيع الحالات المعتمد من قِبل المشرف/ة (النصاب يشمل فقط المستفيدين الحكوميين التابعين للوزارة). متابعة مستجدات الوضع الصحي للمستفيدين مع القسم الاجتماعي والتمريض بشكل دوري. الالتزام بحضور الدورات التدريبية والاجتماعات المعلنة من قِبل الشركة. حضور الفعاليات التي تسهم في تحسين صورة المركز وتبرز دور القسم ودمج المستفيد في المجتمع. المختص ملزم بكل ما ورد في لوائح الشركة والمركز وكل ما يكلف به من المشرف/ة من مهام. التعاون والتفاعل مع روح الفريق. الالتزام بساعات العمل. الكفاءات
