والتطبيقات التقنية. المهارات التواصلية: مهارات ممتازة في التعاون والتفاعل مع الفريق التأهيلي. المحافظة على سرية المستفيدين (تم تصحيح "سر المستفيدين" لتلائم السياق المهني).

01bacd41a24b8ce7.description: Role Summary The Quality Inspector – Safety is responsible for monitoring and ensuring that all construction activities adhere to approved quality standards, safety procedures, and inspection protocols. The role involves conducting daily site inspections, identifying non-compliances, supporting contractors in quality and safety implementation, and coordinating closely with the QC Manager and Resident Engineers. This position plays a vital role in maintaining the integrity, safety, and quality of project execution on site. Key Responsibilities Perform daily site surveillances to ensure ongoing works comply with approved ITPs, checklists, and project requirements. Identify deficiencies, safety issues, and non-compliance on site; report immediately to the QC Manager and initiate corrective actions before work is covered. Ensure proper closure of WIRs (Work Inspection Requests) and MIRs (Material Inspection Requests) after obtaining signatures and verifying all required documentation. Review and understand project specifications, drawings, PQP, ITPs, method statements, QC procedures, and other relevant quality documents. Witness testing and sampling of concrete, soil, steel, and other materials; complete all related forms as per approved procedures. Monitor and comment on contractor quality control and safety practices to ensure compliance. Conduct daily coordination meetings with the contractor’s QC representative to reinforce proper quality management procedures. Assist the Construction team in resolving quality‑related and safety‑related issues. Support the Quality Manager in preparing and conducting internal/external quality audits. Prepare and submit daily QC reports to the QC Manager no later than 9:00 AM the following day. Verify that all testing equipment and devices have valid calibration certificates. Review and maintain logs of WIRs, MIRs, MARs, and other QC documentation. Report any miscoordination between disciplines to the Resident Engineer (RE) and Quality Manager (QM). Qualifications & Requirements 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering, Health & Safety, or a related field. Strong understanding of quality control, site safety practices, testing procedures, and applicable regulations. Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and inspection procedures. Excellent attention to detail and strong reporting/documentation skills. Effective communication and proactive problem-solving approach.

015bc180d08d1ec1.description: The Design Engineering Manager will lead and manage multidisciplinary engineering design activities for petrochemical and oil & gas projects, with a strong focus on oil and gas separation systems . The role is responsible for overseeing design development across project phases, ensuring compliance with international standards, project specifications, and client requirements, while coordinating with EPC teams and stakeholders. This position is based in China. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage engineering design activities for petrochemical and oil & gas projects. Oversee design of oil & gas separation systems , including process facilities and related units. Manage multidisciplinary engineering teams (process, mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation). Review and approve engineering deliverables, calculations, drawings, and technical documents. Ensure engineering designs meet project scope, schedule, quality, and cost objectives. Coordinate with project management, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams. Interface with clients, licensors, vendors, and regulatory authorities. Ensure compliance with international codes, standards, and project specifications. Support technical issue resolution during engineering, procurement, and construction phases. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and performance management for engineering teams. Educational Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline). Master’s degree is an advantage. Experience Requirements Minimum 15 years of engineering experience in petrochemical and oil & gas projects. Proven experience in oil & gas separation systems . Minimum 5 years in a Design Engineering Manager or Lead Engineering role . Strong EPC project experience.

01bd3c0aaca4264f.description: Eram Talent is on the lookout for a skilled Mechanical and Piping Inspector, specifically with Aramco approval, to join our esteemed team in the Oil & Energy sector. As a prominent Talent Acquisition Consultancy, we excel at connecting highly qualified professionals with impactful projects. This role is essential for ensuring the quality, safety, and compliance of mechanical and piping systems in alignment with Aramco standards. As a Mechanical and Piping Inspector, your expertise will ensure that all mechanical and piping installations are up to the requisite standards, thus safeguarding both operational integrity and environmental compliance. You will collaborate closely with project teams to drive the highest standards of quality and safety in our projects. Responsibilities Conduct thorough inspections of mechanical and piping systems in accordance with Aramco standards and specifications. Evaluate the quality of materials and workmanship during the installation and assembly of piping systems. Prepare detailed inspection reports, documenting findings, non-conformances, and recommendations for corrective actions. Collaborate with project management and engineering teams to ensure compliance with project specifications. Perform inspections at various stages of the construction process to ensure all work meets safety and quality standards. Provide technical guidance and support to construction teams to rectify any identified issues. Participate in quality meetings and discussions with stakeholders to communicate inspection findings and address concerns. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Minimum of 8 years of experience in mechanical and piping inspection, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry. Must be Aramco-approved as a Mechanical and Piping Inspector. Strong knowledge and understanding of piping codes, standards, and specifications, including ASME, API, and others related to Aramco projects. Experience with Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods and the ability to interpret inspection results accurately. Excellent analytical skills with a meticulous eye for detail. Strong communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams. Ability to manage multiple tasks while adhering to strict deadlines. Proficient in using inspection tools and software for documentation and reporting.
